name: v67_settlement_event_cleanliness
hypothesis: Litigation/insurance settlement burden is a distinct event-footnote channel; low absolute settlement impact plus low market correlation may avoid the saturated profitability/news/guidance clusters.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_setaq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_setpq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_seta12)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Avoids legal news/relationship terms that were weak in v26; uses low-user fundamental6 settlement vectors directly.

name: v67_domestic_profit_fx_stability
hypothesis: Domestic operating profitability with low FX translation noise may be an underused geographic-quality signal rather than another analyst-yield or reported-FCF near-neighbor.
expression: 0.40 * group_rank(ts_rank(domestic_ebit_value / abs(domestic_assets_total_value), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(foreign_currency_translation_adjustment_net) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(fx_translation_oci_net_tax) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (beta_last_90_days_spy - beta_last_360_days_spy), 90), industry)
notes: Uses domestic/foreign disclosure fields not present in prior candidate history, with only a light risk-relief term.

name: v67_noncontrolling_interest_leakage
hypothesis: Large noncontrolling-interest claims can dilute economic ownership and complicate earnings quality; lower NCI balance/income leakage may be a distinct structural accounting signal.
expression: 0.35 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_mibtq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_miiq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_newqeventv110_cimiiq)) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: A new fundamental6 vector family not covered by employee/SBP/tax/lease cleanliness runs.

name: v67_intersegment_complexity_relief
hypothesis: Lower intersegment eliminations and lower FX income noise may proxy for cleaner segment economics without relying on product/customer graph counts.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(vec_avg(fnd6_intseg)) / abs(sales), 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(fnd6_newqv1300_fcaq) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * abs(foreign_currency_translation_adjustment_net) / assets, 126), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: Tests segment-complexity disclosure, intentionally avoiding PV13/product structure.

name: v67_advertising_intensity_growth
hypothesis: Sustained advertising intensity can proxy for demand investment; ranking it within subindustry may reduce sector-mix noise and create a non-guidance growth signal.
expression: 0.45 * group_rank(ts_rank(fnd6_xad / abs(sales), 126), subindustry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(ts_delta(fnd6_xad / abs(sales), 252), 126), subindustry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * unsystematic_risk_last_90_days, 90), industry) + 0.15 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * correlation_last_90_days_spy, 126), industry)
notes: A non-news marketing/brand-investment route, separate from the weak v58 marketing-news probe.

name: v67_useful_life_conservative_asset_policy
hypothesis: More conservative equipment useful-life assumptions and lower machinery burden may capture asset policy quality differently from the failed PP&E age ratios.
expression: 0.30 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * equipment_maximum_useful_life, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * max_useful_life_buildings_land, 126), industry) + 0.25 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * gross_machinery_equipment_value_2 / assets, 126), industry) + 0.20 * group_rank(ts_rank(-1 * (systematic_risk_last_90_days - systematic_risk_last_360_days), 90), industry)
notes: Small, falsifiable useful-life probe; abandon if it repeats the weak PP&E age behavior.
